issue_context.title: Fullscreening a window causes gamma / redshift to not apply (since 16b0afd43)
issue_context.body:
- **Sway Version:**
  - sway 1.9-dev, commit 51c9376c0

- **Debug Log and Configuration File:**
  - [Gist with config and logs](https://gist.github.com/Ferdi265/1fef25cf61e672d2d564f6aa43f0fa32)

- **Stack Trace:**
  - N/A, is not a crash

- **Description:**
  - start sway
  - start gammastep, or another redshift-like program that changes gamma
  - start an application
  - fullscreen it
  - suddenly, the gamma changes apruptly do not apply any more
  - after unfullscreening, gamma returns to normal

I have bisected the issue and the culprit is commit 16b0afd43. After reverting that commit, everything works fine again.

I have not seen any significant difference in the logs between the fixed and broken versions, but both fixed and broken logs seem to get "Failed to get DMA-BUF from buffer" errors while konsole is fullscreened.
comments: It does :) Issue is fixed with that PR
